author: V.M. Sawh
title: Indie Author Seeking Character Artists for Dark Fantasy Book
content: Attn Artists: I'm an Indie Author looking for experienced character artists for an exciting 2027 dark fantasy book with 10+ full page colour illustrations in a 6x9" hardcover interior. Artists, please link your portfolios. Criteria: 1) NO AI. Real artists only 2) Your portfolio must include at least one Creature/Werewolf/Demon and one Beautiful Woman to be considered 3) Semi/Realistic Illustrations (colour and B&W) 4) Canadian Artists preferred 5) Vibe Check: https://pin.it/15teNuksT Contact by linking portfolios in the replies.

author: Gretchen Ives
title: Seeking Cover Artist for Workplace Romance Trilogy
content: Calling all romance book illustrators! I’m looking for a cover artist for my new workplace romance trilogy series. Currently just looking to order one cover but ideally someone I could work with for several. I need someone who has current availability as this is somewhat urgent, a previous illustrator fell through. Absolutely NO AI please! Would love to see your portfolios. Contact via replies with portfolios.

author: Sega Jenesis
title: Seeking Artists for Custom Pokémon Card Binder Scenes
content: 🎨 I’m on the hunt for digital artists! 👀 I’m planning to order some custom Pokémon card binders as holiday gifts, and I’d love to commission an artist to create a scene or two for them! I’m thinking full illustrated Pokémon scenes, not just individual characters. Is it a little late in the year to be looking for holiday commissions? Maybe. 😂 But here I am anyway! Obviously, this is a PAID commission! I absolutely believe in compensating artists for their time and talent. 💚 If you’re an artist or know someone who might be interested, please send them my way! I’d love to see portfolios, pricing, and availability. 🥰 Contact via DM or replies.

author: Scarlett Wright
title: Seeking Affordable Last-Minute Character Commission Artists
content: Show me artists with affordable last minute commission spots open. I have a tiny bit of money and a desire to see my characters. If you’re an artist, drop your character work below! Contact by dropping character work in the replies.

author: Cassidy Cole
title: Looking for Character Artists for Published and Upcoming Books
content: Looking for character artists who have openings to do some character art for a few of my published and upcoming books!! (Absolutely no AI) Contact via DM on Instagram or replies.

author: Carolina
title: Seeking 2D & 3D Character Designer / Animator
content: Looking for a 2D & 3D Character Designer / Animator! I’m looking for a creative talent who can: * Create flat character illustrations (2D). * Design and develop 3D characters. * Animate characters in both 2D and 3D. Experience in mascot design, character development, and motion animation is a plus. If you’re interested or know someone who fits, please drop your portfolio or tag them below! Email : claracarolinawijaya@gmail.com Contact by email or portfolio drop in replies. No AI.
